method: Reconstruct each original run task directory from its archived task.toml, instruction.md, environment.tar.gz, tests.tar.gz and solution.tar.gz. Hash with Harbor Task.checksum algorithm: dirhash(directory, sha256). Join by original run ID and trial name using the AWS rollout registry, then compare result reward/checksum fields and trajectory session ID plus every step ID/timestamp.
evidence_scope: The recovered checksums identify archived run inputs, not newly generated launch-time attestations. The original recovery markers remain unchanged in result.json. Archived inputs were last modified before the earliest corresponding agent event. Native checksums match for all ten native-result records. Raw licensed inputs and private cloud locations are withheld; archive content hashes and pinned image digests are retained.
